WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS trade_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
overall AS (
  SELECT SUM(trade_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(trade_count) AS avg_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT SUM(tc.trade_count) AS combined_number,
       AVG(1.0 * tc.trade_count / o.total_count) AS average_share,
       AVG(tc.trade_count - o.avg_count) AS average_above_average
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE tc.trade_count > o.avg_count
